# core

Types from PocketBase's Go package `core`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [core](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/core).

Its types are on five pages: this one (the app, `core.App`, and what doesn't fit elsewhere), [Records and collections](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records), [Fields](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/fields), [Events](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/events), [Settings](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings).

## core.App

App defines the main PocketBase app interface.

Note that the interface is not intended to be implemented manually by users
and instead they should use core.BaseApp (either directly or as embedded field in a custom struct).

This interface exists to make testing easier and to allow users to
create common and pluggable helpers and methods that doesn't rely
on a specific wrapped app struct (hence the large interface size).

## core.BaseApp

BaseApp implements CoreApp and defines the base PocketBase app structure.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `findAllAuthOriginsByRecord()` | <code>(authRecord: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">Record</a>): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#coreauthorigin">AuthOrigin</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | FindAllAuthOriginsByRecord returns all AuthOrigin models linked to the provided auth record (in DESC order). |
| `findAllAuthOriginsByCollection()` | <code>(collection: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corecollection">Collection</a>): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#coreauthorigin">AuthOrigin</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | FindAllAuthOriginsByCollection returns all AuthOrigin models linked to the provided collection (in DESC order). |
| `findAuthOriginById()` | <code>(id: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#coreauthorigin">AuthOrigin</a>)</code> | FindAuthOriginById returns a single AuthOrigin model by its id. |
| `findAuthOriginByRecordAndFingerprint()` | <code>(authRecord: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">Record</a>, fingerprint: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#coreauthorigin">AuthOrigin</a>)</code> | FindAuthOriginByRecordAndFingerprint returns a single AuthOrigin model by its authRecord relation and fingerprint. |
| `deleteAllAuthOriginsByRecord()` | <code>(authRecord: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">Record</a>): void</code> | DeleteAllAuthOriginsByRecord deletes all AuthOrigin models associated with the provided record. |
| `createBackup()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, name: string): void</code> | CreateBackup creates a new backup of the current app pb_data directory. |
| `restoreBackup()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, name: string): void</code> | RestoreBackup restores the backup with the specified name and restarts the current running application process. |
| `unsafeWithoutHooks()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coreapp">App</a></code> | UnsafeWithoutHooks returns a shallow copy of the current app WITHOUT any registered hooks. |
| `logger()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger">slog.Logger</a>)</code> | Logger returns the default app logger. |
| `txInfo()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coretxappinfo">TxAppInfo</a>)</code> | TxInfo returns the transaction associated with the current app instance (if any). |
| `isTransactional()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsTransactional checks if the current app instance is part of a transaction. |
| `isBootstrapped()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsBootstrapped checks if the application was initialized (aka. whether Bootstrap() was called). |
| `bootstrap()` | <code>(): void</code> | Bootstrap initializes the application (aka. create data dir, open db connections, load settings, etc.). |
| `resetBootstrapState()` | <code>(): void</code> | Deprecated: use `ClearBootstrap`. |
| `clearBootstrap()` | <code>(): void</code> | ClearBootstrap releases the initialized core app resources (closing db connections, stopping cron ticker, etc.). |
| `db()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | DB returns the default app data.db builder instance. |
| `concurrentDB()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | ConcurrentDB returns the concurrent app data.db builder instance. |
| `nonconcurrentDB()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | NonconcurrentDB returns the nonconcurrent app data.db builder instance. |
| `auxDB()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | AuxDB returns the app auxiliary.db builder instance. |
| `auxConcurrentDB()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | AuxConcurrentDB returns the concurrent app auxiliary.db builder instance. |
| `auxNonconcurrentDB()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuilder">dbx.Builder</a></code> | AuxNonconcurrentDB returns the nonconcurrent app auxiliary.db builder instance. |
| `dataDir()` | <code>(): string</code> | DataDir returns the app data directory path. |
| `encryptionEnv()` | <code>(): string</code> | EncryptionEnv returns the name of the app secret env key (currently used primarily for optional settings encryption but this may change in the future). |
| `isDev()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsDev returns whether the app is in dev mode. |
| `settings()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/settings#coresettings">Settings</a>)</code> | Settings returns the loaded app settings. |
| `store()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/store#storestore">store.Store</a>&lt;string, any&gt;)</code> | Store returns the app runtime store. |
| `cron()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/cron#croncron">cron.Cron</a>)</code> | Cron returns the app cron instance. |
| `subscriptionsBroker()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions#subscriptionsbroker">subscriptions.Broker</a>)</code> | SubscriptionsBroker returns the app realtime subscriptions broker instance. |
| `newMailClient()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/mailer#mailermailer">mailer.Mailer</a></code> | NewMailClient creates and returns a new SMTP or Sendmail client based on the current app settings. |
| `newFilesystem()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemsystem">filesystem.System</a>)</code> | NewFilesystem creates a new local or S3 filesystem instance for managing regular app files (ex. record uploads) based on the current app settings. |
| `newBackupsFilesystem()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem#filesystemsystem">filesystem.System</a>)</code> | NewBackupsFilesystem creates a new local or S3 filesystem instance for managing app backups based on the current app settings. |
| `restart()` | <code>(): void</code> | Restart restarts (aka. replaces) the current running application process. |
| `runSystemMigrations()` | <code>(): void</code> | RunSystemMigrations applies all new migrations registered in the `core.systemMigrations` list. |
| `runAppMigrations()` | <code>(): void</code> | RunAppMigrations applies all new migrations registered in the `CoreAppMigrations` list (PocketOne: or the app's own list, see `AppMigrationsOf`). |
| `runAllMigrations()` | <code>(): void</code> | RunAllMigrations applies all system and app migrations (aka. from both `core.systemMigrations` and `CoreAppMigrations`; PocketOne: or the app's own list, see `AppMigrationsOf`). |
